cohort: 56 patients who presented to the department of surgery at Hayatabad Medical Complex, Peshawar from July 2016 to June 2019 with complications following obstetrical and gynecological procedures.
finding: The most common complications following obstetrical and gynecological surgeries were wound infection (23.2%), haemorrhage (16.1%), and incisional hernia (14%).
followup_time: Varied, patients were followed up in the OPD
